_comment: Engine sampler spec of one National Compute MI355X node (8 x MI355X, vLLM ROCm, TP8) for a
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 async GRPO run (FP8 dense + MXFP4 experts checkpoint, about 510 GB).
Image: the recipe's AgentX MI355X image vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-e68efc685ab1e6f1eda004ced7157e3ca411da2f
(GET /version 0.32.1rc1.dev36+ge68efc685); its server interpreter is python3 and yeto goes on PYTHONPATH.
Engine: vllm-server with model_preset ds41-mi355x (vLLM's DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash recipe for MI355X: MXFP4
sparse indexer, block size 128, AITER MoE, breakable CUDA graphs, Gluon sparse MLA, deepseek_v41
tokenizer / tool / reasoning parsers; no DSpark, no mono decode, no INT4 quick-reduce, Engram tables
resident). In-place reload goes through the yeto worker extension vllm_linear_reload (never vLLM's
reload_weights, which leaves NaN log-probs on this image): a merged attention-only LoRA release is
reloaded in about 1 s; any other release restarts (about 3 min cold start from local NVMe). R3 (routed_experts) works
on this image (uint16 [T, 40, 6]); turn it on in rollout_fields when the trainer replays routing.
The checkpoint has no HF chat template: prompts.format chat renders with the checkpoint's
encoding/encoding.py (chat_template_kwargs go to encode_messages: thinking_mode, reasoning_effort).
Every value in angle brackets is a site value; the store and sampler_id are filled by the pool.
